sample_selection.alternatives_considered_for_sample_slots: MEDIUM slots: A-10, D-09, F-06, A-14, E-04 were eligible; C-05 and D-01 won on the stated verified-evidence/wedge-anchor rules. These are sample-composition alternatives, not scored rejections; all five must appear in the full 24.

scoring_method.scale: Coarse ordinal 0-4 per criterion: 0 = blocking/strongly adverse; 1 = weak/unfavorable; 2 = mixed/neutral; 3 = favorable; 4 = strongly favorable. No finer granularity is claimed.
scoring_method.uncertainty: Each criterion score carries a half-width band: 0.5 (well-evidenced, incl. A30-verified or demonstrated-ledger facts), 1.0 (record-level/corpus-dated or proposed-only mechanisms), 1.5 (reserved for pool-record-only depth; unused in this sample). Aggregate uncertainty = sum of weight x half-width (conservative linear combination; independence is NOT assumed, which quadrature would require). Overlapping aggregate bands mean adjacent ranks are not separated; dispositions rest on gate logic, not on score decimals.
scoring_method.aggregation: score = sum(weight_i x score_i), weights fixed and declared below, reported to one decimal in RANKING.csv (two decimals retained here strictly for ordering audit, not precision).

weights_declared.design_note: Commercial-evidence-side weight (technical_proof + buyer_access + defensibility + time_horizon + capital + geography + regulation) = 0.60; founder-side (founder_goal_fit + phd_leverage + shared_skills) = 0.30; downside = 0.10. PhD leverage matters (0.12, tied for largest single criterion) but structurally cannot override commercial evidence — the task's judgment rule implemented as arithmetic, not rhetoric.

criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.founder_goal_fit: Compatibility with the founder's documented goal state: finish the PhD (P1 revision critical path, G5 gate ~month 12) while preparing an aligned venture, under constraints C42 (international student), C33/C34 (OTL disclosure gates), C49 (zero accepted publications). Distinct from phd_leverage: this asks 'can this coexist with the PhD', not 'does it use PhD assets'.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.time_horizon: Fit of the venture's decisive windows to the founder's remaining-PhD and post-PhD calendar, and verification status of those windows.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.capital: First-proof and early-stage capital demands vs a PhD-parallel founder (lower demands score higher).
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.geography: Market/access location friction (US-accessible vs CN-primary etc.). Person-status friction (clearances, deemed export) is scored under regulation, not here — no double count.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.regulation: Certification/compliance/classification burden of the venture as scoped, including person-status interactions (C42).
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.technical_proof: Evidence state of the venture premise itself: verified demand predicates, incumbency, unproven cores — commercial/technical, founder-independent.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.phd_leverage: B20's bidirectional mechanism class (STRONG/MEDIUM/WEAK/ADVERSE): does the venture's differentiator run through PhD-demonstrated or PhD-proposed assets, and does anything return to the thesis. Scored from B20's adjudication, not re-derived.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.shared_skills: B30 stack position of the venture's needed capabilities: founder-acquirable via named bridge gates (higher) vs missing/collaborator-only (lower). Distinct from phd_leverage: C-05 is MEDIUM leverage with a poor domain-skill path; C-01 is WEAK leverage with a real sliver path — the two criteria pull apart exactly there.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.buyer_access: Reachability of the buyer community for this founder (network overlap, incumbent occupancy of the channel).
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.defensibility: Durable differentiation of the venture as scoped, per record + verified incumbency evidence.
criteria_definitions_and_anti_double_cou.downside: Severity if pursued and it fails: opportunity cost against the thesis, irreversibility, conflict mechanisms (publication/classification). Distinct from founder_goal_fit: goal fit scores the plan; downside scores the failure mode.

scoring_method.semantic_double_counting_guard: A30's SEM ledger governs: E-01 is consolidated inside C-01 (SEM-01) and appears in origin only; B-01/C-04 (SEM-02), E-10/A-13 (SEM-03), C-15/A-21 (SEM-04) do not touch this sample. No idea appears twice; no criterion is scored twice under two names (definitions above draw the lines).

disposition_vocabulary.keep: Commercial and founder evidence both support active pursuit now; no blocking gate; receives primary venture-preparation time.
disposition_vocabulary.bridge: Retained conditional on named B30 bridge-experiment gates; the ONLY permitted founder spend is executing those gates; gate outcomes promote (toward keep) or demote (to watch/stop).
disposition_vocabulary.watch: No founder time beyond monitoring named external triggers; re-evaluate at the named trigger or at the full B40 run.
disposition_vocabulary.stop: No further founder time in any form; leaves active consideration (record retained).
disposition_vocabulary.note: No idea in this sample earns keep. That is a finding, not a gap: every non-WEAK mechanism in the universe runs through proposed-only capabilities gated by C04 and FT-02 (B30's conclusion), so the portfolio's top is bridge-shaped by construction.

sample_top3.reason: Only STRONG alignment in the universe plus rank 1 in both baselines; the decisive leg is exactly the WP-C credential the PhD needs anyway — but it is C04-gated, hence bridge, not keep.

Triple-intersection winner class whose honest founder lane (estimator-honesty detection statistics) is the cheapest gated ladder in B30 (BR-A Phase 0 at $0); demand maturity is its open commercial question.

A30-verified live demand ecosystem and W1-class method-authority moat, held at watch because the founder's domain path (multi-kW calorimetry) does not exist in the ledger and the OCP conformance-vacuum predicate is still discovery-level.

definitions.core_bridge: Ideas whose retention is an explicit bet on named B30 gates; they receive the only active founder work permitted by this pilot — the gates themselves.
definitions.monitored_options: watch-disposition ideas: zero founder time beyond named triggers; re-scored at the full run or on trigger events.
definitions.closed: stop-disposition ideas: no founder time; retained as records and family exemplars only.

bridge_gates: BR-A Phase 0 (FT-02 estimator honesty, $0 desk): gates D-01's entire founder lane and every estimator-based claim (C31: 'gates every dollar after it'); its FAIL branch demotes D-01 to watch/stop.
BR-D (WP-C Tier-1 calibration): gates D-02's credential leg; calendar start = 'immediately upon C04 closure'; its C04-kill branch fires B20's D-02 falsifier.
BR-B (traceable chain + acceptance dossier): rehearses the W1 methodology C-05 and D-02 both cite; dossier failure stops all W1 customer-facing preparation.
BR-G (PB-3 discrimination statistics): the only founder-relevant lane inside C-01's family; FAIL closes the protection-intelligence sliver at founder scale.
dependencies.c04_block: The ~109x bench anomaly (C04) blocks all calibration work by the project's own rule; it gates BR-D, hence D-02's decisive leg and the credential both wedges cite. Closure time honestly not estimable (B30).
dependencies.publication_gate: G5 (~month 12): accepted/in-revision first-author paper AND real-die absolute calibration; C49 records zero accepted today. This gate binds ALL venture-preparation time in every disposition above; failure triggers the corpus's own OPT3 pivot logic.
dependencies.disclosure_gates: C33/C34 (advisor + OTL pre-disclosure screen) bind every public artifact from every bridge; FT-01 prior-art kill search precedes any novelty claim.

sensitivity_cases.case: phd_leverage weight halved (0.12 -> 0.06) and doubled (0.12 -> 0.24), all other weights renormalized proportionally
sensitivity_cases.rank_flips: NONE in either direction — the sample ordering 1-6 is identical at w_phd = 0.06, 0.12, and 0.24.
sensitivity_cases.why_no_flips: For every adjacent pair, the higher-ranked idea has BOTH a higher non-PhD weighted component and a greater-or-equal phd_leverage score (D-02>D-01: 2.52/2.42 and 4/3; D-01>C-05: 2.42/2.31 and 3/2; C-05>C-01: 2.31/1.45 and 2/1; C-01>C-07: 1.45/0.95 and 1/1; C-07>D-10: 0.95/0.65 and 1/0). Under proportional renormalization the pairwise difference is a positive combination of these two gaps, so the ordering is provably stable for ANY phd_leverage weight in [0,1) — not just the two tested values.
sensitivity_cases.gap_movement: D-01 vs C-05 gap: 0.18 (halved) / 0.23 (baseline) / 0.34 (doubled) — the nearest pair tightens when PhD weight falls; D-02 vs D-01: 0.17 / 0.22 / 0.33.
sensitivity_cases.honest_caveat: Total stability here is partly an artifact of the sample's deliberately wide class spread: alignment and integrated commercial scores happen to be monotone-aligned across these six. The full 24 will contain adjacent pairs (e.g., WEAK-high-commercial vs MEDIUM-low-commercial: C-22 vs D-09/F-06 territory) where this dominance will NOT hold and flips are expected; the full run must report them, not suppress them.

limitations: Six-idea pilot: scores and ranks are method-demonstration outputs, not portfolio decisions; the full 24-ranking supersedes everything here.
Aggregate uncertainty bands overlap across ranks 1-3 (and 5-6): within those groups the ordering is judgment inside stated bands, not separation.
Venture-side market facts are corpus-dated except where A30-verified or live-opened this run (B40P-01); the ABB SSCB shipping claim could not be live-verified (two fetch timeouts, disclosed).
All founder-side mechanism scores inherit B10/B20/B30's ground truth, including the pre-redteam status of folder-08 estimator claims (C40).
